newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sun Hung Kai Prop rises on warrant talk.
newsitem.headline: Sun Hung Kai Prop rises on warrant talk.

text.p: Shares of Sun Hung Kai Properties surged on Wednesday on talk of a covered warrant issue, brokers said.
"Talk that at least two merchant banks are planning warrants on the stock fuelled buying," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage.
Sun Hung Kai shares rose HK$2.75 to HK$93.75 in mid-morning trade on volume of 1.96 million shares.

Brokers said there was talk of two covered warrant issues on the stock. One was expected to carry a premium of 15 percent with gearing of 6.7 times, while the other was seen carrying a premium of 19 percent and gearing of 7.14 times, they said.
